name: RCG Practice Test
fullName: SITHGAM022 Provide responsible gambling services (RCG / RSG)
outlineComment: SITHGAM022 Provide responsible gambling services, SIT Tourism, Travel and Hospitality training package, Release 1 (current on training.gov.au, checked 30 Oct 2026; supersedes SITHGAM001, no successor). Elements: 1 implement responsible gambling practices, 2 provide information and assistance on gambling harm and harm minimisation; categories follow the unit's knowledge and performance evidence. The unit is competency based and states call it RCG (NSW), RSG (Vic, Qld) or similar; there is no national pass mark, so 80% is a readiness line. State rules are 'varies by state'. All items original.

categoryNotes.aurcgLaw: PC 1.1, 1.2; KE legislation, codes of practice, roles of staff/supervisors/managers, ramifications of non-compliance, public interest reasons; PE under-age gambling, refusal of credit
categoryNotes.aurcgHarm: PC 2.1; KE signs and impacts of harm from gambling (the 10 listed signs), economic costs
categoryNotes.aurcgOdds: KE signage on chances of winning and probability; PC 2.1 accurate information
categoryNotes.aurcgEnv: PC 1.4, 2.3; KE harm minimisation principles (signage inside venue, clocks, no machine advertising, ATMs, no credit withdrawals); PE passage of time, breaks in play, signage and promotions
categoryNotes.aurcgExcl: PC 2.2; KE self, third-party and venue exclusion, breaches, referral; BetStop for online
categoryNotes.aurcgAssist: PC 2.1, 2.4; KE counselling services and referral, confidentiality and privacy; foundation skills: courteous, discreet, non-confrontational language
categoryNotes.aurcgIncident: PC 1.2, 1.3; KE records of incidents and staff action; PE disputes or complaints
